summary: Backend-only E2E of the 💼 Reseller in-bot application (RESELLER_APPLY_FORM=true) via real bot + mock Telegram. Smoke 30/30. New deep suite 103/103: Back on all steps (answers kept), Cancel btn + /cancel, all validations, stale/unknown rsa: callbacks, Start Over, concurrent double Submit (1 submission, 1 admin alert), status screens (pending_payment / pending std / paid priority w/o withdraw / approved), Apply Now while open, Switch to Standard (status + checkout row), Withdraw (admin buttons removed, admin notified, re-apply works), wallet insufficient wall + concurrent double tap (usdOut exactly 200), BlockBee full/under/over/replay/closed/upgrade-from-standard, DynoPay full + concurrent duplicate/under/over/closed, Fincra NGN exact/over/under/closed, admin decisions (Admins only, approve 24h, reject paid footer 'no automatic refund', second tap 'Already rejected' + buttons removed, re-apply after rejection), fr/zh/hi localized flow, Ask a Question → AI support chat, stk:/stkbuy:/mp: callback regression (no TDZ errors). Escape probe 3/5: main-menu labels typed on free-text steps are saved as answers.

minor.endpoint: Telegram text routing, action 'rsApply' (_index.js ~15259, reseller-apply.js handleInput brand/note cases)
minor.issue: Typed main-menu labels on the free-text steps ('🏠 Main Menu', '👛 Wallet', etc.) are accepted as the Brand name or Note to Admin, and the user stays stuck in the form. Repro: 💼 Reseller → 📝 Apply Now → ⏭ Skip → send '🏠 Main Menu' → saved as brand='🏠 Main Menu', the bot moves to Step 3, action stays rsApply. /start does exit correctly. Fix: in handleInput (or before calling it), treat any known main-menu/user.* button label as an exit (set action none and fall through to normal routing), or reject it as a brand.

There is no rate tolerance. Paying exactly 200 USDT converted to $199.80, so it was treated as an underpayment: the full amount went to the wallet, the app stayed pending_payment and the user got sentLessMoney. No money is lost (the user can 1-tap pay from the wallet), but it's poor UX. Also, if convert() returns null (BlockBee outage), usdIn=null → the sentLessMoney text shows '$null' and addFundsTo refuses the credit, so the payment is silently lost with no admin alert. Older BlockBee handlers have the same pattern. Suggest using resolveCryptoCreditUsd/computeDepositCreditUsd (as DynoPay does) or a ~1-2% tolerance, plus an admin alert when the conversion fails.

Admin alert send has no retry or fallback. One transient ECONNRESET (seen once in the sandbox for a paid DynoPay priority app 50504dc3) just logs '[Reseller] admin alert failed', so the admin never learns about a PAID application. Suggest a retry or a notifyAdmin fallback.

When a Standard app is upgraded by payment, a new admin alert is sent but the old Standard alert keeps live Approve/Reject buttons, and adminMsg is overwritten, so a later withdraw/decision only cleans up the newest message. decide() is atomic so it's harmless, just untidy. Suggest editing out the old alert's buttons before sending the new one.

action_items: Make the rsApply free-text steps (brand/note) not swallow main-menu button labels: exit the form or re-prompt
BlockBee /crypto-pay-reseller: add an underpayment tolerance or use resolveCryptoCreditUsd; handle convert()=null with an admin alert instead of losing the payment
Add a retry/fallback to alertResellerApplication so paid Priority apps are never invisible to the admin
(Nice to have) Remove the buttons from the old Standard admin alert when an app is upgraded to Priority
critical_code_review_comments: State transitions in reseller-apply.js are properly atomic (findOneAndUpdate filters). Double submit, double wallet tap, duplicate DynoPay and withdraw-vs-pay races are all safe. A closed-app payment always ends up in the wallet with the full amount (excess + refund portions add up).
Flag-off path (code review only, not toggled): message === user.becomeReseller → goto.resellerAsk() when RESELLER_APPLY_FORM !== 'true', unchanged from before.

Bank /bank-pay-reseller compares ngnToUsd(ngnIn) < price. An exact ngnPrice payment passed in the test, but a null rate would be treated as an underpayment with no credit (same pre-existing pattern as the other bank handlers).
nodejs.err.log has one old '[Marketplace] callback_query error: Cannot access translation before initialization' for chat 990300104 (from before the fix). No new occurrences during these runs.

rca of the issue: Menu-label escape: the 'rsApply' text branch (_index.js ~15259) runs before the main-menu routing, and handleInput's brand/note cases accept any 2-40 char / ≤500 char text. Only /start is intercepted earlier. Mitigation: check the message against the main-menu button labels (user.* translations) before handleInput and, on a match, set action none and continue routing.
